messages:
Maria: quick heads-up — aiming to cut coordinated bumps across API / runtime / console / SDKs tomorrow. target cutoff: 2026-03-18 16:00 PT. Please confirm compatibility and changelogs by then.
Alex: SG. What's the exact version matrix?
Maria: API -> v1.14.0, runtime -> v0.27.1 (kernel+kv cache tweaks), console -> v3.2.0, sdk-js -> v2.10.0. minor bumps except runtime is patch.
Ken: runtime PR is on release/runtime-0.27; CI green except one perf test flake. tag will be `v0.27.1` after merge.
Priya: console changes include a small UX toggle for rollout (FF: release_ui_bump). I will coordinate the console changelog entry and docs.
devops-bot: CI status: runtime PR #1423 — build: passes, e2e: flaky (1/3), perf-check: pending.
Alex: SDK compatibility question — are there any breaking schema changes on the API? if not, SDK bump can be minor.
Maria: no breaking changes on the API surface — just added an optional field in /streams response. SDKs can remain backwards-compatible.
Sophia: reminder: use the short changelog format we agreed on (one-line summary + migration notes if any). I'll assemble the combined release notes.
Ken: tagging snippet for whoever cuts the runtime tag:
```
# on release/runtime-0.27
git checkout release/runtime-0.27
git pull origin release/runtime-0.27
git tag -a v0.27.1 -m "runtime: v0.27.1 — kernel optimizations, KV caching"
git push origin v0.27.1
```
Maria: checklist (please tick in thread):
- [ ] merge API PR and update openapi.yaml
- [ ] merge runtime PR and verify perf post-merge
- [ ] merge console PR & feature flag staging
- [ ] cut SDK-js v2.10.0 and publish
- [ ] update unified changelog with entries from each repo
- [ ] schedule canary for dedicated and hosted routes

Priya: I'll handle console merge and feature flag. tagging + changelog update will follow my PR.
Alex: I'll bump SDK once API tag exists. ping me when API tag is pushed and I'll open the release PR.
Ken: if perf regression shows up in the post-merge run we revert to v0.26.x kernel and hold cut. fallback plan noted.
devops-bot: Reminder: release window cutoff rule — no schema or contract changes after cutoff. Any doc-only or changelog-only updates ok.
Sophia: If anyone needs migration notes for the optional field in /streams, I can draft a short blurb.
Maria: final ask — try to have PRs merged by 14:30 PT so we can run a full canary cycle before 16:00. I'll cut tags at ~15:00 if everything is green. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex: will do. ping me around 15:00 if anything blocks.
Ken: pinging the runtime perf owners to triage flake now — @Alex @Sophia
Sophia: acknowledged, looking at perf dashboard.
devops-bot: CI update: runtime PR #1423 — perf-check: failed (latency +3%).
Maria: ok, hold on the runtime tag until perf owner confirms regression isn't caused by infra noise. If it's a real regression we rollback change and re-evaluate.
Priya: console merge still OK, proceeding with docs and changelog.
Alex: SDK team standing by. I'll open draft release PRs so we can populate changelog sections early.
Ken: will post back in 20m with perf analysis.
Maria: thanks everyone — quick async please. If you're blocked, drop a short note here so we can reassign. :thumbsup:
